L01_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L01_narrator.wav.text: It was raining heavily on Sunday, so I stayed inside all day.

L02_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L02_narrator.wav.text: I really loved the idea of spending a quiet afternoon at home.

L03_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L03_narrator.wav.text: First, I made a hot cup of tea and grabbed a book.

L04_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L04_narrator.wav.text: I could hear the gentle sound of rain against the windowpane.

L05_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L05_narrator.wav.text: After reading a few chapters, I saw a comedy on television.

L06_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L06_narrator.wav.text: It made me laugh out loud and forget the gray weather.

L07_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L07_narrator.wav.text: Later on, I decided to go into the kitchen for dinner.

L08_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L08_narrator.wav.text: I prepared a warm vegetable soup with fresh bread and butter.

L09_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L09_narrator.wav.text: Eating a hearty meal at home made me feel very relaxed.

L10_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L10_narrator.wav.text: It turned out to be a very peaceful and cozy Sunday.
